objective: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

description: Wild Leather shoulders support a wearer's frame extremely well, offering superior protection of the upper arms as well as the shoulders.  As with all Wild Leather armor, a random yet very potent enhancement is imbued within the item as the wildvine is stitched in.
For this pattern, I will require six thick armor kits and a wildvine.  That shouldn't be too tall of an order for you to fill.
progress: Do you have the six thick armor kits and the wildvine I require?

Think of making armor kits as a lesson in steady and reliable crafting; the consistent fashioning method you develop as you ply your trade on these kits helps develop your skills for the intricate work needed to make Wild Leather armors.
Every lesson has a purpose, <name>. It is important to embrace each one accordingly.
completion: These armor kits are of solid quality, <name>. If there is one thing I demand in not only my work, but in the work of those I give tutelage to, it is quality.
You've done well to earn this pattern; I hope it brings you the rewards it has brought me.
